stem.text: When $X$ is added to $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ and heated under reflux, pentan-2-ol is made.
Which organic product is made when $X$ is heated with a solution of $\text{KCN}$ dissolved in ethanol?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: a five-carbon zig-zag chain with CN on the terminal carbon.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: a branched zig-zag carbon chain with CN on a branch carbon below the chain.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a six-carbon zig-zag chain with CN on the terminal carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a branched zig-zag carbon chain with CN on a branch carbon above the chain.
